sample_mapping_evidence: 30 original ALS patient PBMC expression tables with explicit distinct patient numbers. Ten control records remain held pending cross-study donor identity review. Preserve source rapid/non-rapid categories.

source_processing: Base calling and making fastq files were performed using software provided with the 10X Genomics Cell Ranger (cellranger mkfastq v3.0).
Count data were calculated from fastq files using software provided with the 10X Genomics Cell Ranger (cellranger count v3.0).
Count data were normalized to compare across samples using software provided with the 10X Genomics Cell Ranger (cellranger aggr v3.0).
Supplementary files format and content: Tab-delimited text files include gene symbol and gene expression (read count) for each cell.
